jobs.description:

Responsibilities include screening guests, patrolling the area, and providing assistance to customers.

The role requires excellent communication skills, a high school diploma or GED, and a commitment to safety during events.

Pay ranges from $15.00 to $18.00 per hour, with no additional benefits offered. Candidates must be at least 18 years of age and have reliable transportation.
